items.choice: terminal checks/notices use a new bridge `notice` frame (not a TASK message), serialized with other worker deliveries by the worker delivery lock
items.reason: must work without a Task; same lane discipline as existing deliveries; real-model behaviour to be confirmed in the C-D68 smoke

items.choice: output already returned to a terminal call is not repeated in the next check; first check counts 60 s from that call's end
items.reason: avoids duplicate input; keeps 1-minute cadence relative to the worker's last view

items.choice: aborted or bridge-timed-out wait sends terminal_wait_abandoned so the result is not considered received
items.reason: guarantees the completion notice after abort (C-D68 (8))

items.choice: delivery with transport loss -> unknown, no resend
items.reason: same policy as report_outcome_unknown (no duplicate model turns); visible in journal
